businessCase.operation: Marcar póliza como no renovable con motivo de cambio
businessCase.observedError: No fue posible confirmar el guardado en el servidor. Ningún cambio debe darse por aplicado hasta obtener readback.
businessCase.falseHypothesisDiscarded: El bloqueo de creación en rol Asesor era esperado; con Operativo sí pudo crear póliza. No ampliar Asesor.

sourceOnlyRemedy.intent: Aislar cambio exclusivo de renovabilidad del plan de cuotas y de materialización de cartera, proteger concurrente y exigir auditoría servidor
sourceOnlyRemedy.parallelAuditMutation: actividades append-only entry with motive and operationId
sourceOnlyRemedy.concurrencyGuard: expectedBefore.renovable checked within the same server Firestore transaction; stale values yield failed-precondition
sourceOnlyRemedy.idempotency: requestId from operationId, server eventId and canonical readback
sourceOnlyRemedy.errorHandling: The UI retains operationId plus server code if confirmed unavailable and does not advise blind retry.

roleScope.operativeCrossAdvisor: Allowed ONLY when active Operativo role has explicit tenant roleScope=all and signed membership allows country
roleScope.advisors: Own scope remains; no change to canManagePolicies or advisor privilege
roleScope.moduleRestrictions: Existing explicit module denies and requested none remain effective
roleScope.tenant: Server resolves member from the authenticated request under the requested tenant; no cross-tenant grants

qa.deltaManifestGuard: New successor source must declare replaces(path, priorGitBlobSha, priorChangeId), previous receipts untouched; supersession positive and 3+ fail-closed negative tests pass

deployPrerequisites: Exact current branch tree and active backend function parity
Approved controlled Preview callable, signed Operativo own/cross-advisor and Asesor DENY tests by country
New immutable frontend Preview artifact with module-level readback and rollback
Real LIVE operationId/server error capture or controlled nonfinancial write and authoritative readback
No production data write until explicit LIVE evidence acceptance
